# @lilib/hooks

> A collection of practical React hooks covering state, effects, refs, async data and browser APIs, with TypeScript, SSR and StrictMode support.

- Install: `pnpm add @lilib/hooks`
- React peer dependency: ^16.8.0 || ^17.0.0 || ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0
- Repository: https://github.com/lilibraries/hooks
- Every page below is also available as raw Markdown (the `.md` links).

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/index.md): Install @lilib/hooks and start using more than 50 practical React hooks for async data, state, effects, callbacks, refs and browser APIs.

## Async

- [useLoad](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLoad.md): Load async data in React with request sharing, caching, retries, polling and automatic reloads.
- [useReload](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useReload.md): Reload every useLoad request that shares the same key, all at once.
- [useSubmit](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useSubmit.md): Run create, update and delete requests imperatively with loading and error state.

## Effects

- [useMount](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useMount.md): Run an effect once after the component mounts.
- [useUpdate](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useUpdate.md): Run an effect after the component updates, skipping the initial mount.
- [useUnmount](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useUnmount.md): Run an effect when the component unmounts.
- [useRefEffect](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useRefEffect.md): Like React.useEffect, but refs in the dependency array are compared by ref.current.
- [useRefUpdate](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useRefUpdate.md): Like useUpdate, but refs in the dependency array are compared by ref.current.
- [useLayoutMount](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLayoutMount.md): Like useMount, but runs synchronously before the browser paints.
- [useLayoutUpdate](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLayoutUpdate.md): Like useUpdate, but runs synchronously before the browser paints.
- [useLayoutRefEffect](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLayoutRefEffect.md): Like useRefEffect, but runs synchronously before the browser paints.
- [useLayoutRefUpdate](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLayoutRefUpdate.md): Like useRefUpdate, but runs synchronously before the browser paints.
- [useIsomorphicLayoutEffect](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useIsomorphicLayoutEffect.md): Use React.useLayoutEffect in the DOM and React.useEffect during server-side rendering.

## States

- [useCache](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useCache.md): Cache data for a fixed time and keep components sharing the same cache instance in sync.
- [useToggle](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useToggle.md): Manage a boolean value with toggle, toggleOn and toggleOff actions.
- [useSetState](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useSetState.md): Merge partial state updates like this.setState in class components.
- [useSafeState](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useSafeState.md): Like React.useState, but setting state after unmount has no effect.
- [useControllableState](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useControllableState.md): Manage a value that can be either controlled or uncontrolled.
- [useDelayedValue](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useDelayedValue.md): Delay updates to a value.
- [useMemoizedValue](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useMemoizedValue.md): Keep the previous value until the new value actually changes, using deep comparison.
- [useThrottledValue](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useThrottledValue.md): Throttle a value so it updates at most once per wait time.
- [useDebouncedValue](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useDebouncedValue.md): Debounce a value so it updates only after it stops changing.

## Callbacks

- [useRaf](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useRaf.md): Invoke a callback before the browser repaints with requestAnimationFrame.
- [useIdle](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useIdle.md): Invoke a callback when the browser is idle, falling back to setTimeout.
- [useAnimate](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useAnimate.md): Run JavaScript animations with a percent-based step callback and an optional easing function.
- [useTimeout](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useTimeout.md): Execute a callback after a delay, with start and cancel controls.
- [useInterval](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useInterval.md): Run a callback repeatedly at a fixed interval, with start and cancel controls.
- [usePersist](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/usePersist.md): Keep a stable function identity while always calling the latest logic.
- [useRerender](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useRerender.md): Re-render the component manually, usually for mutable data.
- [useThrottle](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useThrottle.md): Create a throttled version of a callback.
- [useDebounce](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useDebounce.md): Create a debounced version of a callback with flush and cancel controls.

## Refs

- [useLatestRef](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLatestRef.md): Keep a ref pointing to the latest value to avoid stale closures.
- [usePreviousRef](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/usePreviousRef.md): Keep a ref pointing to the value from the previous update.
- [useComposedRef](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useComposedRef.md): Compose multiple refs, including callback refs, into a single ref.
- [useMountedRef](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useMountedRef.md): Get a ref that tells whether the component is mounted.
- [useUnmountedRef](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useUnmountedRef.md): Get a ref that tells whether the component is unmounted.

## Browser

- [useTitle](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useTitle.md): Set the document title.
- [useFavicon](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useFavicon.md): Set the document favicon.
- [useOnline](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useOnline.md): Detect whether the browser is online.
- [useDarkMode](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useDarkMode.md): Detect whether the system prefers a dark color scheme.
- [useMatchMedia](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useMatchMedia.md): Determine whether the document matches a media query.
- [usePageVisible](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/usePageVisible.md): Detect whether the page is visible, including restores from the bfcache.
- [useWindowFocus](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useWindowFocus.md): Detect whether the window has focus.
- [useHotkey](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useHotkey.md): Bind a keyboard shortcut to a callback.
- [useKeyPressed](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useKeyPressed.md): Detect whether a key is currently held down.
- [useClickOutside](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useClickOutside.md): Trigger a callback when a click happens outside the target area.
- [useEventListener](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useEventListener.md): Attach an event listener to a target and clean it up automatically.
- [useScroll](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useScroll.md): Track the scroll position, direction, and progress of the page or an element.
- [useScrollLock](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useScrollLock.md): Lock scrolling of a container, the page by default.
- [useWindowSize](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useWindowSize.md): Get the window size and update on resize.
- [useElementSize](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useElementSize.md): Observe the size of a DOM element.
- [useIntersecting](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useIntersecting.md): Detect whether an element intersects the viewport or a given root element.
- [useResizeObserver](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useResizeObserver.md): Observe size changes of an element with ResizeObserver.
- [useMutationObserver](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useMutationObserver.md): Observe DOM mutations such as inserted or removed nodes and changed attributes.
- [useIntersectionObserver](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useIntersectionObserver.md): Observe changes in the intersection of an element with another element or the viewport.
- [useCookie](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useCookie.md): Get, set and remove cookies, using js-cookie as the parser.
- [useLocalStorage](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useLocalStorage.md): Get, set and remove localStorage values.
- [useSessionStorage](https://lilibraries.github.io/hooks/useSessionStorage.md): Get, set and remove sessionStorage values.
